summary: @nebula.js/cli 7.1.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime into a temp directory, chmods the binary executable (0755), and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {cwd: D})`. The sibling file `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, a large string/constant array and a rotating shuffle function `WV8StW`) whose behavior is opaque to Node-based static analysis and only executes under the freshly dropped Bun runtime, evading Node-oriented scanners. Package metadata claims the identity of the qlik-oss `@nebula.js/cli` project (author `QlikTech International AB`, repository `github.com/qlik-oss/nebula.js`), but the legitimate upstream package has no such preinstall dropper — consistent with an impersonation or compromised publish. On a default `npm install`, the preinstall hook fires automatically and runs the obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime dropped from the network.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
